recommending.label: Recommending / Advising
recommending.when: to suggest a course of action or steer a choice

phrases.t: This is ideal for anyone who …
It would be well worth considering …
If you're thinking of …, I'd say …
All things considered, I would recommend …

tasks.question: Would you recommend a restaurant you've recently visited?

cues.cue: restaurant / suit / anyone who enjoys authentic local food
models: I would highly recommend this restaurant, especially if you enjoy authentic local food.

cues.cue: visit / be / well worth booking in advance
models: It's well worth booking in advance, particularly for weekend evenings when tables fill up quickly.

cues.cue: tasting menu / offer / something for every palate
models: You can't go wrong with the tasting menu, since it offers something for every palate, which makes it ideal for larger groups.

cues.cue: restaurant / not / suit those on a tight budget
models: I wouldn't recommend it unless you're happy to spend a little more, because the prices reflect the quality of the ingredients.

cues.cue: place / suit / anyone celebrating a special occasion
models: This is ideal for anyone celebrating a special occasion, since the atmosphere feels genuinely memorable.

cues.cue: diners / consider / booking a window table
models: It would be well worth considering booking a window table, given that the view adds so much to the experience.

tasks.question: What advice would you give someone visiting your country for the first time?

cues.cue: travellers / avoid / the city centre during rush hour
models: My advice would be to avoid the city centre during rush hour, as this would save considerable time getting around.

cues.cue: visitors / try / the local markets early in the morning
models: One thing I'd suggest is trying the local markets early in the morning, which would help you avoid the crowds.

cues.cue: tourists / consider / getting a public transport pass
models: It would be well worth considering a public transport pass, given that it covers most of the popular sights.

cues.cue: first-time visitors / suit / a guided walking tour
models: This is ideal for first-time visitors, since a guided walking tour gives a great overview of the city's history.

cues.cue: travellers / plan / their trip outside peak season
models: I would highly recommend planning your trip outside peak season, especially if you want to avoid the busiest crowds.

cues.cue: visitors / learn / a few basic phrases beforehand
models: If you're thinking of visiting, I'd say it's worth learning a few basic phrases, especially since locals really appreciate the effort.

tasks.question: Would you recommend a course or class you've taken?

cues.cue: course / suit / anyone serious about improving quickly
models: I would highly recommend this course, especially if you're serious about improving quickly.

cues.cue: enrolment / be / well worth the investment
models: It's well worth the investment, particularly for anyone planning to use the skills professionally.

cues.cue: beginners / not / suit an overly fast-paced structure
models: I wouldn't recommend it unless you're already fairly confident, because the pace moves quickly from the very first week.

cues.cue: students / consider / attending the optional workshops
models: It would be well worth considering the optional workshops, given how much extra practice they provide.

cues.cue: course / suit / anyone wanting a structured, guided approach
models: This is ideal for anyone wanting a structured, guided approach rather than independent study.

cues.cue: students / choose / the intensive version overall
models: All things considered, I would recommend the intensive version, particularly because it covers far more material in less time.

tasks.question: What advice would you give someone choosing a smartphone or laptop?

cues.cue: buyers / think / carefully about battery life first
models: My advice would be to think carefully about battery life first, as this would matter more day-to-day than most other features.

cues.cue: shoppers / compare / prices across several retailers
models: One thing I'd suggest is comparing prices across several retailers, which would help you avoid overpaying.

cues.cue: buyers / consider / how much storage they'll actually need
models: It would be well worth considering how much storage you'll actually need, given how quickly files and photos build up.

cues.cue: device / suit / anyone who values a long-lasting build
models: This is ideal for anyone who values a long-lasting, well-built device over the latest features.

cues.cue: buyers / avoid / the very newest model unless
models: I wouldn't recommend the newest model unless the extra features genuinely matter to you, because the price jump is considerable.

cues.cue: shoppers / buy / refurbished to save money
models: If you're thinking of buying refurbished, I'd say it's a great option, especially since the savings can be significant.
